reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 30. Nay or No: 9. Not Voting: 1. Of 39 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 35 (90%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 210 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

I enjoyed stopping by Sugar and Spice Laura’s Delights in Montgomery City for a cup of coffee and a productive discussion with Mayor Mike Spirz and other local community leaders! https://t.co/voVCGf3guq

With 62 FastLane locations across 20 counties, the company employs over 1,100 hardworking Missourians. Local businesses play an essential role in supporting Missouri’s economy and creating jobs in our communities! Thank you to Wayne and his team for having me.

Thank you to Carlos Quintana and Kelly Pruitt for welcoming State Rep. Jeff Myers, Samantha Richardson with Main Street Real Estate, Mayor Eric Schleuter, and me. We enjoyed touring the facility, learning more about https://t.co/nXLB0YcnWO

Small businesses are the backbone of our Missouri communities, creating jobs, driving innovation, and strengthening our local economies. That is why @HouseGOP passed the Working Families Tax Cuts Act, making the 20% small business income deduction permanent so entrepreneurs can keep more of their hard-earned money and reinvest in their employees and operations.

I had the pleasure of speaking with Laurie West, owner of Overstock Outlet in Warrenton, about her creative approach to offering shoppers discounted merchandise and unique finds, as well as how I can continue fighting for small business owners across #MO03 in Washington.

Missouri’s greatest strength has always been our hardworking, skilled workforce.

As a physician and Representative of #MO03, I will always support the https://t.co/3Bp8YHrnMZ

A report released Saturday by @Open_the_Books revealed that more than $225 million in taxpayer dollars was stolen through fraud in the public school system over a seven-year period. 

Thank you to @GovMikeKehoe and @VP for their support alongside @HouseGOP to root out fraud, hold those responsible accountable, and protect hardworking American taxpayers from abuse.

I had a great visit with @fishwindowclean. Founded 1978, Fish Window Cleaning has grown into a nationwide franchise with 275 locations, all while keeping its headquarters right here in Missouri!

Their organization is a great example of Missouri entrepreneurship, creating jobs, supporting small businesses, and demonstrating how companies headquartered in #MO can succeed nationwide!

When the medicine our children take, the antibiotics hospitalized patients depend on, and the drugs millions of Americans rely on are manufactured overseas, we face more than a healthcare issue. We face a national security vulnerability.

🚨 Read more about this growing concern in my latest op-ed in @thehill!

Missouri is leading the way in American manufacturing, and companies like PierTech Systems are a great example of the innovation and craftsmanship happening right here in #MO03!

I enjoyed touring one of PierTech’s facilities in Weldon Spring today to learn more about their expertise in foundation construction and repair equipment, including helical piers, piles, and anchors. With multiple locations across our district, PierTech is strengthening American manufacturing, supporting local jobs, and demonstrating the importance of producing high-quality products here at home.

It was an honor to visit the Mid America Veterans Museum in O’Fallon, Missouri. Since its founding in 2019, the museum has relied on the dedication of its staff and volunteers to preserve the stories and sacrifices of the brave soldiers, sailors, airmen, and Marines who gave their lives in service to our nation.

The museum serves as a powerful reminder of the price of freedom and the importance of ensuring that the courage and sacrifice of our fallen heroes are never forgotten.

I stopped by @Porta_King in Montgomery City to learn more about their work manufacturing modular buildings, flooring, and insulation for a wide range of applications, including security facilities, military installations, and border crossings. Founded in 1969, Porta-King now employs more than 100 people and continues to play an important role in Missouri’s manufacturing industry.

Thank you to the Porta-King team for taking the time to share their story and for the work they do to support our local economy and community!

As a physician, I know firsthand how a life-changing diagnosis can remind us how precious every moment is. Life is a gift we should never take for granted. Early detection, access to quality care, and continued advancements in treatment can make all the difference.

This Breast Cancer Awareness Month, we recognize the importance of regular screenings, stand with the women and families affected by this devastating disease, honor those we have lost, and celebrate the strength of survivors and the healthcare professionals who continue to bring hope to those fighting breast cancer.

For six decades, the @Mizzou Research Reactor (MURR) has been at the forefront of groundbreaking nuclear research and medical innovation. As the only U.S. producer of isotopes used to treat liver, thyroid, prostate, and pancreatic cancers, MURR helps one million patients every year.

I appreciated the opportunity to speak at MURR’s 60th anniversary celebration about the importance of supporting cutting-edge research right here in Missouri and producing these lifesaving treatments in America to ensure patients across our state and the nation have reliable access to the care they need.

I had a productive meeting with members of the Callaway County Commission to discuss the latest developments on a new Emergency Operations Center in #MO03 that will strengthen emergency preparedness and ensure local emergency responders have the resources they need to keep Missouri families safe.

I really enjoyed my visit to Interstate Regional Stockyards in Crawford County, where I had the opportunity to watch a live cattle auction and speak with stockyards owner Scott Abolt, members of the Crawford County Commission, Sheriff Layman, Mayor Pitts Lesane, and local business and agricultural leaders about the importance of supporting Missouri’s livestock producers and strengthening our state’s agricultural industry.

.@HouseGOP passed historic legislation to lower taxes, reduce federal spending, and deliver lasting reforms that cut red tape and give American families and businesses more opportunities to succeed.

Listen to my conversation with @AVPMikeFerguson on @NewstalkSTL below! https://t.co/ynkdNw9sx7

I had the opportunity to tour Cottleville with Mayor Stephen Thompson, meet with local business owners, discuss the city’s continued growth, and see firsthand the work being done to strengthen our community.

Hearing directly from the Missourians I represent helps me better understand their priorities and how I can continue advocating for #MO03 in Washington to ensure our communities have the resources they need to thrive.

Our Navy’s greatest asset has always been the brave men and women who wear the uniform. Their courage, discipline, and willingness to sacrifice for a cause greater than themselves embody the very best of American greatness.

Happy 251st birthday to the @USNavy! For more than two and a half centuries, the United States Navy has defended our nation, safeguarded our freedoms, and remained a formidable force for American strength around the world. Today, we honor the generations of sailors who have answered the call to serve and continue to defend the freedoms our Founding Fathers fought to protect.

It was an honor to meet with Cottleville Chief of Police Dave McCune to discuss the important work his department is doing to keep the community safe and thank him and his officers for their dedicated service.

Our law enforcement officers put their lives on the line every day to protect Missouri families and keep our communities safe. I remain committed to standing with our men and women in blue and ensuring they have the necessary resources and support.

I enjoyed meeting with Ron Black of the @NSPE to discuss the important role Missouri’s engineers play in strengthening our infrastructure, driving innovation, and supporting economic growth.

With so much new development underway across #MO03, the expertise and hard work of our engineers are critical to turning these projects into reality and helping our communities continue to grow and thrive.

Today, on Columbus Day, we recognize the courage and determination of Christopher Columbus, whose historic 1492 voyage connected the Old World and the New World.

His voyage helped set in motion the events that ultimately led to the establishment of the American colonies and the founding of the United States. We honor his spirit of exploration and willingness to venture into the unknown, which forever changed the course of history.

I enjoyed catching up with Mayor Stephen Thompson and local business leaders from Great Southern Bank, Frontline Inspections, Leaps & Bounds, Peoples Bank & Trust, MaidPro, Forest Park Capital, and Autumn and Blues at the Cottleville-Weldon Spring Chamber of Commerce!

We had a great discussion about how we can continue working together to support our local businesses and strengthen #MO03.

The alleged actions of these two illegal aliens are absolutely heinous. This has unfortunately become far too common in our nation. Our prayers are with the victim, a 17-year-old girl and her family.  

I commend the Washington County Sheriff’s office for their quick action and hope for swift justice. These men must be held accountable for their actions, deported and never allowed to enter our country again. 

https://t.co/4JqzRZMZe0

I had such a great time visiting Brewer Science in Maries County and learning more about their work developing next-generation materials. Since 1981, Brewer science has been at the forefront of innovation in advanced packaging and smart devices, making an impact in industries around the world.

Thank you for allowing me to hear about all the incredible work that you do and for all the things you do to give back to the community. It is inspiring to see a Missouri company making a global impact while remaining dedicated to the people and communities here at home!

I had the pleasure of visiting Appliance Outlet Superstore and meeting with the owner, Tyler Monda. It was great to learn more about his business and hear about the work he is doing to serve customers and families in our community.

Thank you to Tyler for taking the time to meet with me and share his story. Local businesses like Appliance Outlet Superstore play such an important role in keeping our community strong!

I had a wonderful time joining the Mayor of Cuba, Pitts Lesesne to visit Hayes Family Shoe Store and meet with the owner Jeff Bouse. 

Since 1950, Hayes Family Shoe Store has been a great example of a local business that helps make our community so special for generations.  Thank you to Mayor Pitts for showing me around!

It was an honor to stop by the Cuba Chamber of Commerce lunch at the Cuba Fire House to speak with constituents during Fire Safety Month and discuss the importance of fire safety in our community.

A heartfelt thank you goes out to all our volunteer firefighters for the time, dedication, and hard work they put in to protect our families and neighborhoods. Your willingness to serve and keep our communities safe does not go unnoticed, and we are incredibly grateful for all that you do.

I had a wonderful time visiting Clenin Farm Supply with Mayor Mike Staton, Prosecuting Attorney Derik Kinde, Jake Vogel, and State Representative Willard Haley. It was great hearing directly from a local business serving farmers, and families and learning more about the work they are doing to support our community.

Thank you to Tyler Clenin for taking the time to share Clenin Farm’s story and for their continued commitment to Missouri agriculture and the local community.

It was a pleasure to meet with Burger Smokehouse and Pittman Farms at Grind Coffee and Bistro. 

I appreciated the opportunity to hear about the work they are doing and the work they plan on doing to strengthen our community. Thank you for sharing your experiences and for the hard work you do to support Missouri families, agriculture, and local communities. 

A special thank you to Mitch Rademan for helping bring everyone together and making this possible.

I had a great time visiting Co-Mo Connect and learning about their longstanding commitment to serving communities across the region. For generations, Co-Mo Connect has worked to provide reliable electric power and internet connections, helping families, farmers and businesses stay connected. 

Thank you to Co-Mo Connect for taking the time to speak with me and for the many years of service you have provided our community.

Three years ago, the world watched in horror as Hamas terrorists tortured and murdered over 1,200 people and took over 250 as hostages, including many women and children. These acts of terror marked the deadliest attack on the Jewish people since the Holocaust. 

We must continue to remember the victims, and pray for Israel and the brave men and women protecting it. May we never forget the pure evil we witnessed on October 7, 2023.
